module: Global utilities specific to the vehicle VM, loaded by require("ve_utils"): high-precision timer, conversion of header-style jbeam tables to a list of dictionaries, saving compiled jbeam as text, contrast colors, generation of interpolated curves (Catmull-Rom) and psi -> Pa conversion. The module does not return a useful table M: everything is defined as a global function.
usage:
local t = HighPerfTimer()
-- ... work ...
local ms = t:stop() -- duration in milliseconds
local curve = createCurve({{0,0},{1000,50},{7000,200}})
local torque = curve[floor(rpm)]
notes: The functions are global (no ve_utils. prefix); a `require` is enough to define them.
HighPerfTimer: os.clockhp() is in seconds, getTime/stop/stopAndReset return milliseconds.
_HighPerfTimer:getTime() returns the absolute clock in ms (os.clockhp()*1000), not the elapsed time: for the duration, use stop().

createCurve: the x of the points must be increasing integers (the index of the resulting array is x itself, from floor(x1) to floor(xn)). With returnArray=true and ffi available, returns a C float[?] of size xn+1, 0-based.
createCurve with 3 or more points uses a Catmull-Rom spline; with 2 points a straight line; with fewer than 2 returns nil.
PSItoPascal adds 101325: the result is an absolute pressure, not relative.
getContrastColor/getContrastColorStringRGB cycle over 17 colors (i % 17) of the jetColor palette.
saveCompiledJBeamRecursive writes a pseudo-JSON (key order not guaranteed because of pairs()) and does not escape the quotes of strings.

HighPerfTimer.desc: Creates a high-precision timer started at the moment of creation (based on os.clockhp).

returns.desc: _HighPerfTimer object with the methods reset, stop, stopAndReset, getTime.

tableFromHeaderTable.desc: Converts a jbeam table in the "first row = header, following rows = values" format into a list of dictionaries {column=value}. A row that is a lone dictionary defines common options applied to the following rows; a dictionary placed in the last column merges its options into the row. If a row has an id field, it is renamed name.

returns.desc: List of rows (empty table if entry is empty), or false if the header/a row is invalid (a warning is logged).

saveCompiledJBeamRecursive.desc: Recursively writes a data table in JSON-like text format to an open file, with indentation depending on the level and a header comment for each table having a partPath.

level.desc: Current recursion level (0 at the start).

saveCompiledJBeam.desc: Saves compiled jbeam data to a text file (opens, writes via saveCompiledJBeamRecursive, closes). Used for debugging.

returns.desc: false if the file could not be opened (warning logged), otherwise true.

getContrastColor.desc: Returns a game color taken from the jet palette according to the index, to distinguish curves or debug elements.

getContrastColorStringRGB.desc: Same palette as getContrastColor but returns a CSS hexadecimal string.

createCurve.desc: Builds a dense lookup table from points {x, y}: an array whose index is x (integer) and whose value is the interpolated y. Straight line for 2 points, Catmull-Rom spline for 3 or more. Used for example for engine torque curves.

points.desc: List of {x, y} with increasing integer x.

returnArray.desc: If true and ffi is available, returns a C float[] array (0-based) instead of a Lua table.

returns.desc: Table keyed by x, or nil if fewer than 2 points.

PSItoPascal.desc: Converts a relative pressure in psi to an absolute pressure in pascals: psi * 6894.757 + 101325.

_HighPerfTimer.desc: Timer returned by HighPerfTimer(). Stores the start time in seconds in self[1].

reset.desc: Restarts the timer at the present moment.

stop.desc: Returns the time elapsed since the start, in milliseconds, without restarting.

stopAndReset.desc: Returns the elapsed time in milliseconds and restarts the timer.

getTime.desc: Returns the absolute high-precision clock in milliseconds (not the elapsed duration).
